exposure: previous history of gestational diabetes mellitus
cohort: The study included 597 mothers attending postnatal wards at Teaching Hospital Anuradhapura during October 2023.
finding: The prevalence of preterm birth was 9.5% in Anuradhapura Teaching Hospital, and several maternal factors including mode of delivery, pregnancy outcome, previous history of preterm labour, previous history of gestational diabetes mellitus, consanguinity, stressful events during pregnancy, pregnancy complications, and vaginal candidiasis were significantly associated with it.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with preterm birth.
